title: MONKEY ISLAND 2: LECHUCK'S REVENGE
subtitle: LucasArts, 1991 · the non-interactive demo, on ScummVM 0.6.1's SCUMM engine (v5)
argsHint: -p<dir> where the game is, then its name. Other switches of 0.6.1: -g<scaler> (normal, 2x, 3x, 2xsai, super2xsai, supereagle, advmame2x, advmame3x, hq2x, hq3x, tv2x, dotmatrix), -f for full screen, -m<volume> for the music, -s<volume> for the sound effects, -n to show subtitles (off by default; with speech, the text is shown too).
fpsNote: A FALLBACK cap only: the engine paces itself on the SDL clock.

needsData.hint: monkey2-demo/ from monkey2-dos-ni-demo-en.zip, the demo the ScummVM project distributes

_why: ScummVM 0.6.1 stops this demo after its opening scene, in its own debugger (room 5 not in room 5 in mi2demo.001) -- natively as here, and the reference holds that too (gate-scummvm).
